title: The banner is 21 tab stops deep
detail: A modal layer that blocks the page should receive focus immediately. Here the keyboard user must traverse the page behind the banner before reaching it.

title: IP address disclosed to Google Fonts on load
detail: These hosts are not trackers, but loading them discloses the visitor's IP to a third-country recipient. German courts have treated the Google Fonts case as actionable; self-hosting removes it.
reference: GDPR Chapter V — disclosing an IP address to a third-country recipient is a transfer

title: Reject-all was honoured for the observation window
detail: No consent-requiring third-party requests were seen after the refusal.
reference: ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3) — storing or accessing information on a user's device requires prior consent unless strictly necessary
